integrity: The full labeled profile domain through five goods is enumerated, and an independent type-count reduction reconstructs the same counts from compositions and multinomial weights. The explicit witness, symmetry classes, optimizer multiplicities, and utility profiles are replayed from the packaged verifier.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification concerns two agents, complete allocations, additive item values exactly in {1,2}, and at most five goods. It does not address larger instances, other bi-valued ratios, more agents, or other fairness guarantees.
title: Five goods are the sharp incompatibility boundary for Nash welfare and leximin under positive bi-valued utilities
